y-m-43-02.title: Duba dalilan 'kamar lambobi' na Yerin
y-m-43-02.topic: Matrix biyu waɗanda samfurin su shine matrix sifili (AB=O)
y-m-43-02.goal: Gwada ko dukiyar da ke riƙe da lambobi za a iya ɗauka zuwa matrices kamar yadda yake, yi misali inda AB=O amma ba A ko B ba shine matrix sifili kuma bayyana dalilin amfani da dukiya na A, kuma zaɓi yanayin da ƙarshe ya riƙe.
y-m-43-02.material: Ana rubuta matrix jere a jere, kuma abin da ke gaban semicolon (;) shine jere na farko. Misali, [1 1; 0 1] shine matrix wanda layin farko shine 1, 1 kuma jere na biyu shine 0, 1. E shine matrix na ainihi [1 0; 0 1], kuma O shine matrix sifili tare da duk shigarwar 0. Don lambobi, idan ab=0 to a=0 ko b=0. Yerin ya ce, 'Matrices ma suna da ka'idoji don ƙarawa da haɓakawa, don haka idan AB=O to A=O ko B=O.' A cikin wannan aikin A=[1 2; 24] yana gyarawa, kuma A ba matrix na sifili bane. 2 4

y-m-43-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi ɗaya a cikin labarin Yerin wanda ba shi da tushe.
y-m-43-02.s.s1.hint.0: Rarraba kowane layi cikin sanarwa game da lambobi, sanarwa game da matrices, ko ƙarshe.
y-m-43-02.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo layin da zai iya zama tushen layi na 3, kuma kwatanta ko ya faɗi wani abu a cikin hanya ɗaya da layi na 3.
y-m-43-02.s.s1.line.0: Domin lambobi, idan ab=0 to a=0 ko b=0.
y-m-43-02.s.s1.line.1: Matrices kuma suna da dokoki don ƙarawa da haɓaka, kamar lambobi.
y-m-43-02.s.s1.line.2: Don haka ga matrices ma, idan AB=O sai A=O ko B=O.
y-m-43-02.s.s1.line.3: A gaskiya, idan A = O to AB=O ko menene B.
y-m-43-02.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 tsalle ne. Layin 1 daidai ne game da lambobi, kuma layi na 2 kawai ya ce matrices ma suna da dokoki, ba wai suna 'ka'idoji ɗaya da lambobi' ba. Layin 4 shima daidai ne, amma yana faɗin hanya ɗaya kawai, 'idan A=O to AB=O'. Abin da layi na 3 ke buƙata shine akasin shugabanci (idan AB=O to A=O ko B=O), don haka layi na 4 baya goyan bayan layi na 3. Ko dukiya da ke riƙe da lambobi kuma tana riƙe da matrices dole ne a gwada su daban.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.prompt: Domin A=[1 2; 2 4], yi biyu daban-daban B=[p ; r s] tare da AB = O inda B ba shine matrix na sifili ba. Sannan bayyana dalilin da yasa irin wannan B ya kasance.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta abubuwan shigarwa guda huɗu na AB cikin sharuddan p, q, r, s, saita kowanne zuwa 0, kuma ƙidaya adadin ma'auni daban-daban da suka fito.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.hint.1: Duba daban a ma'auni na ginshiƙi na farko (p, r) da na shafi na biyu (q, s), kuma zaɓi ƙimar da ta gamsar da su ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Layi na farko na AB duk shine 0.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Layi na farko na AB yana da shigarwa mara sifili. Rubuta shigarwar-jere na farko cikin sharuddan p, q, r, s.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Layi na biyu na AB kuma duk 0. Don haka AB=O.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Layi na biyu na AB yana da shigarwar mara sifili.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.ok.c3: B ba matrix na sifili bane.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.fail.c3: B shine matrix sifili. Kuna buƙatar nemo B wanda ba matrix ɗin sifili ba.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.explain: Misali, idan B=[-2 0; 1 0], sai AB=[0 0; 0 da 0]. Babu A ko B shine matrix sifili amma samfurin shine matrix sifili, don haka layin 3 na Yerin baya riƙe. Ba da misali ɗaya ya isa ya karya 'kullum'. A wannan karon, B waɗanda suke da yawa na juna (misali [-2 0; 1 0] da [-4 0; 2 0]) ana ƙidaya su azaman misalai daban-daban.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Don B da kuka yi kawai, rubuta a cikin jumla ɗaya ko biyu dalilin da yasa AB ya zama matrix sifili, yana ambaton dukiya ɗaya na A.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tare da B da kuka yi a sama, rubuta ƙimar da kuke samu ta ninka layin farko na A tare da ginshiƙin farko na B da ƙara.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Sanya layuka biyu na A (1, 2 da 2, 4) gefe da gefe kuma fara rubuta a cikin jumla ɗaya menene alakar da suke da ita.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Shin dalilin da kuka rubuta ya kai ga dukiya ta A (cewa abin da ke tabbatar da shi shine 0, cewa layukansa sun daidaita, da sauransu), ko kun sake maimaita 'saboda AB shine O'?
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Shin a zahiri kun ninka B guda ɗaya da kuka yi ta A kuma ku bincika lambobi cewa ya zama matrix sifili?
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Shin kun yi tunanin ko B guda ɗaya zai yi aiki idan A ya canza (misali A = [1 0; 0 1])?
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Ƙididdigar A shine 1 × 4-2 × 2 = 0, don haka babu matrix mai juyayi. Don haka idan ka ɗauki ginshiƙi ɗaya na B kamar (-2, 1), samfurin tare da A yana ba da 0, kuma AB = O na iya faruwa koda B ba matrix ɗin sifili bane.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Layi na biyu na A shine sau 2 a jere na farko, don haka idan kayi jere daya kawai 0, layi na biyu ya zama 0 kai tsaye. Idan ka ɗauki ginshiƙin B a matsayin (2, -1), sannan 1×2+2×(-1)=0.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Wani samfurin amsa, wanda aka bayyana ta hanyar ma'aunin alakar layuka.
y-m-43-02.s.s3.prompt: Lokacin da A ba matrix na sifili ba, wane yanayi zai baka damar kammala 'idan AB=O to B=O'?
y-m-43-02.s.s3.hint.0: Ka tuna da wannan A da B da kuka yi a mataki na baya, kuma ku duba ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko kowane yanayi yana riƙe da wannan A.
y-m-43-02.s.s3.hint.1: Da farko bayyana cikin kalmomi dalilin da ya sa, ga lambobi, ab=0 da a≠0 za su baka damar ce b=0, ta amfani da 'raba ta a', sannan ka yi tunanin abin da ke taka rawar rarraba a matrices.
y-m-43-02.s.s3.o.a: Duk shigarwar A ba lambobi ba ne
y-m-43-02.s.s3.r.a: Wannan A=[1 2; 2 4] kuma yana da duk shigarwar da ba sifili ba, amma akwai misali inda B ba matrix na sifili bane. Haɗa tare da misali daga mataki na baya, wannan yanayin bai isa ba.
y-m-43-02.s.s3.o.b: A^2, murabba'in A, shima ba matrix na sifili bane
y-m-43-02.s.s3.r.b: A^2=[5 10; 10 20] Hakanan ba matrix zero bane, amma akwai misali tare da B≠O. Yanayin iri ɗaya ne lokacin da kuka ɗauki ikon A.
y-m-43-02.s.s3.o.c: Akwai matrix wanda ke ba da E idan aka ninka shi da A
y-m-43-02.s.s3.o.d: A matrix murabba'i ne (2×2) kuma ba matrix na sifili ba
y-m-43-02.s.s3.r.d: Wannan A kuma ya kasance 2×2 kuma an bayyana wani misali. Girman matrix baya bada garantin wannan ƙarshe.
y-m-43-02.s.s3.explain: Idan A yana da matrix mai juzu'i A^(-1), ninka A^(-1) a hagu na bangarorin AB=O yana bada B=O. Wannan daidai yake da yanayin cewa mai ƙayyade ba shine 0. Akasin haka, idan ƙaddarar ta kasance 0, misali tare da B≠O na iya tasowa, kamar yadda ya faru a wannan lokacin.

y-m-43-04.topic: Ma'anar samfurin matrix: layuka da ginshiƙan tebur mai yawa da teburin farashi
y-m-43-04.goal: Bayyana abin da za a iya ƙididdigewa lokacin da aka ninka tebur biyu da abin da ke sa sakamakon ya zama ma'ana, fassara ma'anar shigarwar sakamakon, kuma bayyana abin da shigarwa ɗaya na lissafin tare da oda da aka canza.
y-m-43-04.material: Ana rubuta matrix jere a jere, kuma abin da ke gaban semicolon (;) shine jere na farko. Misali, [1 1; 0 1] shine matrix wanda layin farko shine 1, 1 kuma jere na biyu shine 0, 1. E shine matrix na ainihi [1 0; 0 1], kuma O shine matrix sifili tare da duk shigarwar 0. A makaranta, Class 1 da Class 2 suna siyan burodi da madara a matsayin abun ciye-ciye. Tebur mai yawa N yana da layuka don azuzuwan (jere na farko Class 1, jere na biyu Class 2) da ginshiƙai don abubuwa (gurasa ta farko, madara shafi na biyu): N = [3 2; 1 4]. (Aji na 1 yana siyan burodi 3 da madara 2, Class 2 yana siyan burodi 1 da madara 4.) Tebur farashin P yana da layuka don abubuwa (gurasa ta farko, madarar jere na biyu) da ginshiƙan shagunan (shagon shafi na farko X, shagon shafi na biyu Y): P=[1500 1800; 1000 1200]. (The unit is 원. A shagon X, burodi ne 1500원 da kuma madara ne 1000원 / a shagon Y, burodi ne 1800원 da madara 1200.) Suna so su nemo jimlar kudin ga kowane aji da kowane shago. Jiho ya ce, 'kawai ku ninka N da P a cikin wannan tsari,' Seoa ya ce, 'Dukansu 2 × 2 ne, don haka ninka P da N kuma ana iya ƙididdige su, don haka tsari ba shi da mahimmanci.' 원

y-m-43-05.title: Tattara matrices waɗanda suka zama matrix na ainihi idan an yi murabba'i
y-m-43-05.topic: Matrices gamsarwa A^2=E da abubuwan gama gari
y-m-43-05.goal: Tabbatar ta hanyar yin misalan cewa mafita na x^2=1 na lambobi, biyu kawai, sun fi yawa don matrices, nemo kuma ku tsara kaddarorin gama gari a cikin misalan da kuka yi, kuma ku bayyana tare da lissafin dalilin da yasa wannan ya bambanta da lambobi.
y-m-43-05.material: Ana rubuta matrix jere a jere, kuma abin da ke gaban semicolon (;) shine jere na farko. Misali, [1 1; 0 1] shine matrix wanda layin farko shine 1, 1 kuma jere na biyu shine 0, 1. E shine matrix na ainihi [1 0; 0 1], kuma O shine matrix sifili tare da duk shigarwar 0. Domin lamba x, idan x^2=1 sai x=1 ko x=-1. Don matrix 2 × 2 A = [a b; c d], nemo A wanda zai gamsar da A^2=E. Abubuwan shigarwar ba lallai ba ne su zama lamba, amma idan kun kimanta ƙimar tushen murabba'i da ƙima, amsa daidai za ta iya fitowa a matsayin kuskure, don haka yana da kyau a yi amfani da lamba ko lambobi waɗanda suka fito daidai, kamar 0.6 da 0.8. (A^2 shine matrix A wanda aka ninka sau biyu, ba kowane shigarwa mai murabba'i ba.)

y-m-43-06.title: Za mu iya yarda domin nau’i-nau’i guda ya yi aiki?
y-m-43-06.goal: Tantance faɗaɗa ƙa’idar da ta ɗauki nau’i-nau’i guda da ya yi aiki a matsayin hujjar gaskiya, ƙirƙiri matrix da furucin ke karyewa a kansu, bincika sharadin karyewar, sannan rubuta martani bisa sakamakon.
y-m-43-06.material: Ana rubuta matrix layi bayan layi, gaban semicolon (;) layi na farko ne. Misali [1 1 ; 0 1] yana da layi na farko 1, 1, na biyu 0, 1. E matrix na ainihi [1 0 ; 0 1] ce, O matrix sifili ce mai duk ƙididdigogi 0. Determinant na matrix 2×2 M=[a b ; c d] ana rubuta |M|=ad−bc. Doyun ya ce, “Determinant na jimillar matrix biyu daidai yake da jimillar determinant ɗinsu, wato |A+B|=|A|+|B|.” A matsayin hujja ya gwada A=[1 0 ; 0 0], B=[0 1 ; 1 0], kuma |A+B|=|[1 1 ; 1 0]|=−1, |A|+|B|=0+(−1)=−1, sun yi daidai.
y-m-43-06.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri misalin ƙaryatawa kai tsaye, sannan bincika sharadin karyewar
y-m-43-06.prereq.1: Lissafin determinant |M|=ad−bc na matrix 2×2 (M=[a b ; c d])

y-m-43-06.s.s1.o.a: Domin nau’i-nau’i guda ya yi aiki, za mu iya ɗauka sauran nau’i-nau’i ma haka suke.
y-m-43-06.s.s1.r.a: Wannan hukunci ne da ya faɗaɗa nasara guda ga duk yanayi. Gwajin neman nau’i-nau’i inda bai yi aiki ba ya ɓace.
y-m-43-06.s.s1.o.b: Akwai misali da ya yi aiki, saboda haka an yanke cewa da’awar ƙarya ce.
y-m-43-06.s.s1.r.b: Misali guda da ya yi aiki ba ya sa da’awa ta zama ƙarya. Abin da ke ƙaryata ta shi ne misalin da bai yi aiki ba (counterexample).
y-m-43-06.s.s1.o.c: An yi hujja da nau’i-nau’i guda, don haka sai an duba babu kuskuren lissafi, ba a buƙatar misalin ƙaryatawa.
y-m-43-06.s.s1.r.c: Wannan hukunci ya ɗauki misali guda a matsayin tabbatar da “kullum”. Ko lissafin daidai ne, kewayon da nau’i-nau’i ke wakilta ƙunƙuntacce ne.
y-m-43-06.s.s1.o.d: Hujjar nau’i-nau’i guda rauni ce, ya kamata a gwada ƙari don ganin ko akwai nau’i-nau’i da ke karya ta.
y-m-43-06.s.s1.explain: Misali guda da ya yi aiki hujja ce mai rauni cewa da’awa gaskiya ce. A wannan karon yawancin ƙididdigogin A sun kasance 0, saboda haka ƙimomin biyu sun yi daidai bisa sa’a. Don gwada da’awa dole a nemo nau’i-nau’i da ke karya ta.
y-m-43-06.s.s2.prompt: Idan A=E matrix na ainihi [1 0 ; 0 1], ƙirƙiri B=[p q ; r s] guda 3 masu |E+B| da |E|+|B| daban. Ƙididdigogi lambobi cikakku ne, kuma B da suke da ƙimar (p+s) da |B| iri ɗaya a ɗauke su misali guda.
y-m-43-06.s.s2.hint.0: A sa ƙididdigogin B p,q,r,s, sannan rubuta E+B da determinant ɗinsa.
y-m-43-06.s.s2.hint.1: Jera furucin faɗaɗa biyu na |E+B| da |E|+|B| gefe da gefe, nemo ɓangaren da ya bambanta.

y-m-43-06.s.s2.ok.c2: |E+B| da |E|+|B| sun bambanta. Ƙa’idar Doyun ta karye.

Don haka idan p+s≠0 ƙa’idar Doyun ta karye; idan p+s=0 tana aiki bisa sa’a ga wannan A (=E). Nau’i-nau’in da Doyun ya gwada da farko ma irin wannan sa’a ne.

y-m-43-10.title: Ƙirƙirar maɓalli don warware lambobi cikakku da aka rubuta a lambar sirri.
y-m-43-10.topic: Ƙirƙirar key matrix mai inverse matrix mai shigarwa lambobi cikakku.
y-m-43-10.goal: Yi hukunci ko za a iya amfani da key matrix, ƙirƙiri key ɗin da za a iya warwarewa da lissafin lambobi cikakku kawai, sannan bayyana sharadin da tsarin inverse matrix.
y-m-43-10.material: Ana rubuta matrix layi bayan layi; abin da ke gaban semicolon (;) shi ne layi na farko. Misali, [1 1 ; 0 1] tana da layi na farko 1, 1 da na biyu 0, 1. E ita ce identity matrix [1 0 ; 0 1], O kuma matrix sifili mai shigarwa 0. Ana ɗaukar lambobi cikakku biyu (x, y) a matsayin vector shafi [x ; y], sannan key matrix K=[a b ; c d] ta ninka daga hagu, ta fitar [ax+by ; cx+dy] a matsayin saƙo. Na’urar mai karɓa tana iya lissafa lambobi cikakku kawai, saboda haka tana ninka inverse matrix na K a kan saƙon don dawo da (x, y); ba za a iya amfani da ita ba idan inverse ɗin yana da kaso. Tsarin inverse: idan ad-bc≠0, to K^(-1) = (1/(ad-bc)) · [d -b ; -c a].

y-m-43-10.s.s1.prompt: Cheolsu ya ce zai yi amfani da K=[2 1 ; 4 2] a matsayin maɓalli. Wane hukunci ne ya fi dacewa game da maɓallin?

y-m-43-09.material: Ana rubuta matrix layi bayan layi; abin da ke gaban alamar semicolon (;) shi ne layi na farko. Misali [1 1 ; 0 1] tana da layi na farko 1, 1 da layi na biyu 0, 1. y-m-43-09.s.s1.st.2.info: An auna wannan ƙima da ma’auni aka karanta k=9: x+2y=4, 2x+4y=9. (Ba tabbatacce ba ne k daidai 9 ne.)

y-m-43-09.s.s1.st.2.after: Ya kamata ya zama 2(x+2y)=8, amma ma’auni na biyu ya ce 9, saɓani ne. Idan k=9 daidai ne, babu mafita. Tunda ƙimar aunawa ce marar tabbas, zaɓi d, a sake duba k, ma yana da ma’ana.
y-m-43-09.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Idan k=9 daidai ne, babu mafita.
y-m-43-09.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Mafita guda ɗaya ce kawai: (x, y)=(2, 1).
y-m-43-09.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Saka (2, 1) cikin ma’auni na biyu yana ba da 5, ba 9 ba. Sake tunani ko akwai mafita guda idan ɓangarorin hagu suna da dangantakar ninki.
y-m-43-09.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wataƙila an ci gaba da amfani da hukuncin k=8. Duba yadda ma’auni na biyu ya bambanta da ninkin 2 na farko idan k ya zama 9.
y-m-43-09.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Babu mafita. Amma da farko a duba ko k daidai 9 ne.

Kada ka ce mafita guda ce domin yawan ma’aunai da abubuwan da ba a sani ba daidai ne. Faɗi matakin da ka tabbatar da hukuncinka da wanda sabon bayani ya sa ka canza shi.
y-m-43-09.s.s2.prompt: Canza ma’auni na biyu zuwa 2x+ny=k, ƙirƙiri nau’i-nau’i 3 masu n dabam da za su sa mafita ta zama guda ɗaya, kuma a wannan mafitar x da y duka tabbatattu ne, y kuma ƙasa da 2. (Ma’auni na farko x+2y=4 bai canza ba.)

y-m-43-09.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi n guda, bayyana x ta amfani da y daga ma’auni na farko, saka cikin na biyu, ka rubuta y a matsayin furucin k.

y-m-43-09.s.s2.explain: Idan n ba 4 ba ne, mafita guda tana ƙayyaduwa ta y=(k-8)/(n-4), x=4-2y. Misali, n=5 da k=9 yana ba y=1, x=2; n=6 da k=9 kuma y=1/2, x=3. Dole y ya fi 0 kuma ya yi ƙasa da 2 domin x ma ya zama tabbatacce.

y-m-43-01.title: Duba warwarewar faɗaɗawar Hyeonu
y-m-43-01.topic: Ninkin matrix da dokar musayar wuri: faɗaɗa (A+B)^2
y-m-43-01.goal: Bincika layi bayan layi ko ƙa’idar faɗaɗawa da ake amfani da ita a lissafin lambobi za a iya amfani da ita ga matrix yadda take, ƙirƙiri matrix da ƙa’idar ke karyewa, sannan tantance siffofin matrix da ƙa’idar ke aiki a kansu.
y-m-43-01.material: Ana rubuta matrix layi bayan layi, abin da ke gaban alamar semicolon (;) shi ne layi na farko. Misali [1 1 ; 0 1] yana da layi na farko 1, 1 da na biyu 0, 1. E matrix na ainihi [1 0 ; 0 1] ne, O kuma matrix sifili ne mai duk ƙididdigogi 0. Akwai matrix A=[1 1 ; 0 1] da B=[1 0 ; 1 1]. Hyeonu ta faɗaɗa (A+B)^2 kamar haka. A ɗauka za a iya amfani da yarjejeniyar ƙari da ninkin matrix kawai a kowane layi, nemo layin da aka rubuta ba tare da hujja ba. (A² na nufin ninka matrix A da kansa sau biyu.) (2×2).
y-m-43-01.thinking.0: Nemo layin da ya tsallake ba tare da hujja ba a warwarewar
y-m-43-01.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri misalai da kanka inda ƙa’idar ba ta aiki (misalan ƙaryatawa)
y-m-43-01.thinking.2: Tsara sharadin yanayin da ƙa’idar take aiki

y-m-43-01.prereq.1: Lissafin ninkin matrix 2×2 (haɗa ƙididdigogi na layi na farko da ginshiƙi na farko, da sauransu)
y-m-43-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi ɗaya a warwarewar Hyeonu da ba za a iya samo shi daga yarjejeniyoyi kaɗai ba. Wasu layuka kuma suna kama da daidai ta lissafi.
y-m-43-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kwatanta kowane layi da na gabansa, gano abin da ya canja.
y-m-43-01.s.s1.hint.1: Da A da B na wannan tambaya, ƙididdige AB da BA kai tsaye, kwatanta ko sakamakon iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-43-01.s.s1.line.1: = A·A + A·B + B·A + B·B (rarrabawa, amma a bar tsarin ninkawa yadda yake)
y-m-43-01.s.s1.line.2: = A² + AB + AB + B² (a ɗauka rubuta AB maimakon BA abu ɗaya ne) A² + AB + AB + B². A2 and B2.
y-m-43-01.s.s1.explain: Matsalar tana layi na 3. Layi na 2 yana da AB da BA dabam, amma layi na 3 ya sake rubuta BA a matsayin AB. Ga lambobi ab=ba, don haka musanya ya halatta; amma ga matrix babu yarjejeniya cewa AB=BA. Layi na 4 ya gaji wannan sake rubutawa, saboda haka furucin ba ya aiki gaba ɗaya. Amma wannan ba yana nufin warwarewar ba ta aiki ga kowace A, B ba. A yanayin AB=BA, yana aiki yadda yake. Bincika a matakai na gaba.
y-m-43-01.s.s2.prompt: A bar A=[1 1 ; 0 1] yadda take, sannan ƙirƙiri B=[p q ; r s] daban-daban guda 2 inda AB da BA suka bambanta. p, q, r, s lambobi cikakku ne daga −3 zuwa 3.
y-m-43-01.s.s2.hint.0: A sa ƙididdigogin B su zama p, q, r, s, sannan rubuta ƙididdigogi huɗu na AB da BA kowannensu.
y-m-43-01.s.s2.hint.1: Jera ƙididdigogin AB da BA gefe da gefe ɗaya bayan ɗaya, gano waɗanne za su iya bambanta.
y-m-43-01.s.s2.var.p: Ƙididdigar p a layi na farko, shafi na farko na B

y-m-43-01.s.s2.var.r: Ƙididdigar r a layi na biyu, shafi na farko na B
y-m-43-01.s.s2.var.s: Ƙididdigar s a layi na biyu, shafi na biyu na B
y-m-43-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Abubuwan da aka shigar sune lamba daga -3 zuwa 3.
y-m-43-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Da fatan za a sanya adadin shigarwar daga -3 zuwa 3.
y-m-43-01.s.s2.ok.c2: AB da BA sun bambanta. Maganar Hyeonu ta ƙarshe ta ƙare don wannan B.
y-m-43-01.s.s2.fail.c2: AB da BA iri daya ne. Yi lissafin shigarwar guda huɗu na samfuran biyu ɗaya bayan ɗaya kuma kwatanta.
y-m-43-01.s.s2.explain: Misali, idan B=[1 0; 1 1], sai AB=[2 1; 1 1] da BA=[1 1; 12], wanda ya bambanta. Tunda (A+B)^2 - (A^2+2AB+B^2) = BA - AB, na B inda AB da BA suka bambanta, magana ta ƙarshe ta Hyeonu ba daidai ba ce. Don wannan A, idan shigarwar a jere na biyu, ginshiƙin farko na B ba 0 ba ne, ko shigarwar diagonal biyu na B sun bambanta, AB da BA sun bambanta. 1 2
y-m-43-01.s.s3.prompt: Zabi duk B ɗin da (A+B)^2 = A^2 + 2AB + B^2 ke riƙe da gaske lokacin da A = [1 1; 0 1]. Kada ku zabi da ido; yana da kyau a duba wasu daga cikinsu ta hanyar lissafta kai tsaye.
y-m-43-01.s.s3.hint.0: Saka siffar da aka faɗaɗa ta (A+B)^2 gefe da gefe tare da A^2+2AB+B^2, kuma ku tsara yadda ake rubuta bambancinsu da AB da BA.
y-m-43-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kafin a ƙididdige AB da BA ga kowane ɗan takara, da farko a duba shigarwar da ta raba AB da BA a matakin da ya gabata (shigarwar a jere na biyu, shafi na farko, da bambancin shigarwar diagonal guda biyu).
y-m-43-01.s.s3.r.a: Wannan shine ainihin B wanda AB da BA suka bambanta a matakin baya. Wataƙila har yanzu ba ku haɗa cewa sharadi don riƙe kalmar 'AB da BA daidai suke'.

y-m-43-03.title: Sanya batu wanda aka matsa sau biyu baya zuwa farkon
y-m-43-03.topic: Tsarin sauye-sauye masu zuwa da matrices masu juyayi
y-m-43-03.goal: Yi hukunci da abin da kuke buƙatar sani don warware sakamakon yin canje-canje guda biyu a jere, zaɓi matrix ɗin da ke warware shi, kuma nemo maki kai tsaye wanda sakamakon ya kasance daidai lokacin da aka canza tsari.
y-m-43-03.material: Ana rubuta matrix jere a jere, kuma abin da ke gaban semicolon (;) shine jere na farko. Misali, [1 1; 0 1] shine matrix wanda layin farko shine 1, 1 kuma jere na biyu shine 0, 1. E shine matrix na ainihi [1 0; 0 1], kuma O shine matrix sifili tare da duk shigarwar 0. An rubuta aya (x, y) azaman vector shafi [x; y], kuma ana ninka matrix daga hagu don matsar da batu. Matrix A=[1 1; 0 1] yana motsa batu (x, y) zuwa (x+y, y), da B=[2 0; 0 1] yana motsa batu (x, y) zuwa (2x, y). A da B dukansu suna da matrices masu juzu'i. An yi amfani da A da B sau ɗaya kowanne, a cikin wani tsari, ɗaya bayan ɗaya, zuwa wani matsayi. Mun san kawai sakamakon sakamakon kuma muna so mu dawo da ainihin batu. Matrix mai juzu'i na A an rubuta A^(-1), kuma matrix na B an rubuta B^(-1).
y-m-43-03.thinking.0: Yi hukunci akan ƙarin bayanin da ake buƙata

y-m-43-03.thinking.2: Nemo shari'o'in kai tsaye waɗanda basu dogara da tsari ba
y-m-43-03.prereq.1: Samfuran matrices 2 × 2 da ƙididdigewa na ninka vector shafi ta hanyar matrix
y-m-43-03.prereq.2: Samun damar karɓar ma'anar matrix mai juzu'i (matrix wanda ke ba da E lokacin da aka ninka) da kuma gaskiyar cewa lokacin da matrices biyu duka suna da matrix mai juzu'i, samfurin su kuma yana da matrix juzu'i.
y-m-43-03.s.s1.prompt: Chaerin ya ce, 'Mun yi sauyi sau biyu kuma A da B kowanne yana da matrix mai juzu'i, don haka za mu iya dawo da ma'anar asali.' Don yanke shawarar yadda za a dawo da shi, menene kuma dole ne mu sani banda wannan?
y-m-43-03.s.s1.hint.0: Don batu (1, 2), bi abin da ya haifar a cikin yanayin da aka fara yin A sannan kuma B, kuma a yanayin da aka fara yin B sannan kuma A.
y-m-43-03.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta ko sakamakon shari'o'in biyu iri ɗaya ne, kuma idan ba haka ba ne, yi tunanin ko hanyar da za a warware su zata iya zama iri ɗaya.
y-m-43-03.s.s1.o.a: x-coordinate da y-coordinate na ainihin batu
y-m-43-03.s.s1.r.a: Idan kun san ainihin batu, ba kwa buƙatar dawo da shi. Yadda za a gyara ba a yanke shawarar ba ta dabi'un batu amma ta tsari na canje-canje da matrices.
y-m-43-03.s.s1.o.b: Wanne na A da B aka fara amfani dashi
y-m-43-03.s.s1.o.c: Ko A^(-1) da B^(-1) matrix iri daya ne
y-m-43-03.s.s1.r.c: A da B sun bambanta, don haka matrices biyu na juzu'i ma sun bambanta. Ko sun kasance ɗaya ba bayanin da ke yanke shawarar yadda za a soke ba.
y-m-43-03.s.s1.o.d: Ko abin da ya haifar ba shine asalin ba
y-m-43-03.s.s1.r.d: Ko sakamakon shine asalin ko a'a, kuna warware shi da matrix iri ɗaya. Wataƙila kun yi tunanin hanyar ta dogara da ƙimar batu.
y-m-43-03.s.s1.explain: Yadda za a gyara ya dogara da 'abin da aka fara yi'. Idan ka fara shafa A sannan ka yi B zuwa ga ma’ana (1, 2), sai ya zama (6, 2), idan ka fara shafa B sannan ka yi A, sai ya zama (4, 2). Sakamakon ya bambanta, don haka hanyar da za a soke ba za ta iya zama iri ɗaya ba. Ba a buƙatar ƙimar batu don yanke shawarar matrix ɗin da ke warwarewa.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.prompt: Yanzu kun san cewa 'A an fara yi sannan kuma B'. Wane matrix ne ke ba da maƙasudin asali lokacin da aka ninka su zuwa wurin da aka samu?
y-m-43-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ma'anar asali (1, 2) ta zama (6, 2) ta A sannan B. Aiwatar da kowane ɗan takara zuwa wannan (6, 2) kuma duba ko (1, 2) ya dawo.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.hint.1: Lokacin da aka yi amfani da samfurin matrix zuwa wuri, yanke shawara ko an fara fara amfani da matrix na dama ko matrix na hagu, kuma a daidaita shi da wane matrix shine canji na ƙarshe.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.r.a: Lokacin da kuka ninka samfurin matrix B^(-1)A^(-1) akan ma'ana, ana fara fara amfani da na dama, A^(-1). Kwatanta wannan tare da tsarin da kuka soke farawa daga canji na ƙarshe.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.r.b: Matrix ɗin da ke ƙara ɓangarori biyu baya warware batun sau biyu amma yana ƙara sakamako biyu. Aiwatar a jere da ƙara sun bambanta.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.r.c: Matrix mai juzu'i na A+B ba shine juzu'in amfani da A da B a jere ba. Jima'i aiki ne daban-daban daga yin ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.explain: Idan ma'anar ta motsa ta A sannan B, sakamakon shine B(A x) (ainihin batu x an ninka farko da A sannan kuma sakamakon ya ninka da B). Don gyara shi, dole ne ka fara gyara na ƙarshe da aka yi, B (B^(-1)), sa'an nan kuma ka gyara A (A^(-1)). Lokacin da ake ninka matrices, ana fara amfani da matrix dama, don haka shine A^(-1) B^(-1). Misali: lokacin da ainihin batu (1, 2) ya zama (6, 2), B^ (-1) ya ba da (3, 2) kuma A^ (-1) ya dawo (1, 2).
y-m-43-03.s.s3.prompt: Shin akwai ma'ana wanda sakamakon ya kasance iri ɗaya ko wane tsari? Nemo kuma shigar da maki biyu daban-daban (x, y), ba asalin ba, wanda 'sakamakon yin A farko sannan B' da 'sakamakon yin B farko sannan A' iri daya ne.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta cikin sharuddan x da y madaidaitan ma'anar da aka samu ta amfani da A farko sannan B zuwa batu (x, y). Rubuta harka inda aka fara yin B ta hanya ɗaya.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.hint.1: Lokacin da kuka saita mahaɗin farko na maki biyu daidai, duba abin da ya rage tsakanin x da y.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.ok.c1: Maki ne tare da haɗin gwiwar lamba kuma x ba 0 ba.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.fail.c1: Da fatan za a sanya shi matsayi tare da haɗin gwiwar lamba da x ba 0 ba.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.ok.c2: Sakamakon umarni guda biyu iri ɗaya ne. (Haɗin kai na farko ɗaya ne, kuma haɗin kai na biyu koyaushe y.)
y-m-43-03.s.s3.fail.c2: Sakamakon umarni biyu sun bambanta. Rubuta sakamakon A farko sannan B da sakamakon B da farko sannan A kowanne a matsayin (x, y) kuma kwatanta.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.explain: Idan kayi A farko sannan B, (x, y) ya wuce (x+y, y) ya zama (2x+2y, y). Idan kayi B da farko sannan A, yana wucewa ta (2x, y) kuma ya zama (2x+y, y). Domin daidaitawar farko ta zama daidai, 2y=y, wato, y=0. Don haka odar ba ta da mahimmanci kawai ga maki akan axis x, kuma ga sauran maki tsari yana canza sakamakon.
